description: Full-text search of dataset catalogues on SBB and cantonal/city Opendatasoft portals; one portal or all in parallel (per-portal errors are reported, not fatal). Returns portal, dataset_id, title, short description, record count, last-modified date and themes; pass portal + dataset_id to get_portal_dataset / query_portal_records. Examples: {query:'passagierfrequenz', portal:'sbb'} (passengers per station), {query:'rollmaterial', portal:'sbb'}, {query:'Parkhaus'} (real-time parking), {query:'Rhein Temperatur', portal:'basel-stadt'}, {query:'Wahlen'}. Metadata is mostly German: use German terms. Omit query (with a portal) to list its most recently modified datasets.

limit.description: Max results per portal (capped at 15 when searching all portals)

portal.description: Optional portal (id/alias/domain). Omit to search all registered portals in parallel.

name: search_portal_datasets
title: Search datasets on Swiss Opendatasoft portals
